title: FingerHopTap
author: Firm_Hedgehog_6789
selftext: So this is not full AI, it is my work started 2006 in Unity when I was big fan of Guitar Hero game and still studied on IT college. After 20 years I digged up an old HDD with backups and run into my old backed up code.Never finished job because I didn't know how to make graphics, but game worked , literally it was all 256bit graphics. Now 20years later I have used AI for graphics to built what I have here for final product. It took 8 months of testing to get to this point. Bugs, glitches and all kind of different things that AI helped me to solve. For examle never know how to push game to PlayStore and how to use monetization, for this Codex helped a lot, also it helped me to review my old code and to make algorithym better for recognizing music , you can upload your own song and start tapping. It was really hard work for one person to push this to end. Like I said not all AI, but like 40-60 in favor of AI because of Graphics and speed that it brought to my programming work. All music is AI btw, but with my lyrics. I have applied for production and waiting Google Play to release it in about 7 days. Also made custom controller for this game if you check out my yt channel (you can click on video)  you will see how it looks like. Game is on Croatian and English, and will make Reedeem code giveaway when game comes out.
